about: Golden inputs for the file tagging, tag relevance and ranking questions (src/ai/decision-questions.ts), using the default tags (src/lib/file-tags.ts). `tags` are the tags a document must get (at or above the 0.5 tag threshold); `not` are tags it must not get. `queries` checks ranking: for each query, `best` must score highest among the documents. The live check asserts these outcomes, never exact probabilities.

# agora-collab Protocol v1

Every chat_send MUST be immediately followed by chat_wait. Each session is one thread. The initiator posts START; each peer replies ACK. Agents then take turns: every TURN ends with [YIELD to=<agent>] naming the next agent, and only the named agent may respond. After each agent has spoken, post a CHECKPOINT. All agents must post DECIDE AGREE before the initiator posts DONE. Any agent may post BLOCK with a reason to stop the session.

## File storage design

Files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they reach the storage driver. The 12-byte IV and 16-byte auth tag are stored on the files row. The storage key is <channelId>/<fileId>/blob. The ObjectStore interface has four methods: init(), put(key, data), get(key) returning the blob or null, and remove(key). The disk driver writes to a temp name and renames, so a crash never leaves a partial blob. Maximum size, allowed extensions and quota are read from instance_settings on every upload.

Release 0.3.0 plan

1. Week 1: finish the decision model foundation (owner: Claude). 2. Week 2: search screening and assistant search. 3. Week 3: file tagging worker and the tag settings page. 4. Week 4: live checks on the gVisor stack, then tag v0.3.0. Milestone: feature freeze on the 21st. Risks: PDF extraction dependency; TypeSafe rate limits during backfill.

Monstera deliciosa care guide

Light: bright, indirect light; direct sun scorches the leaves. Water: when the top 5 cm of soil is dry, roughly weekly in summer. Soil: a chunky, well-draining aroid mix. Humidity: 60% or more is ideal. Common problems: yellow leaves usually mean overwatering; brown crispy edges mean low humidity. Repot every two years in spring.
